trello.name: Send final DataBridge renewal terms email
trello.desc: Sofia to send a final plain language email to the DataBridge account manager today requesting revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business. If no reply is received by Thursday COB, escalate the issue to legal on Friday morning for review of termination-for-convenience options without waiting for further approval.

trello.name: Request Dana's review of security audit cryptography findings
trello.desc: Sofia to contact Dana today and ask her to review sections 4 and 6 of the external security audit report focusing on cryptography and key management findings. Dana should send her assessment to the group before the next sync meeting in two weeks. If Dana lacks bandwidth, escalate the request to her manager after asking nicely.

trello.name: Update rebrand FAQ with logo decision
trello.desc: Tomas to add a line to the rebrand FAQ this week stating the decision that the logo will remain unchanged and only the color palette will be refreshed. Include a link to the March meeting notes where this decision was made to prevent recurring questions.
